subject: highlighting markers on linkage map plot

messages.author: c68e2a9412504c7a
messages.subject: highlighting markers on linkage map plot
parts:
Hi Karl,

I have a simple question--is there a way for R/QTL to plot linkage groups and allow certain markers (which I specify) to be highlighted in that plot? I know you can do something like this in plot.qtl(), but this requires running makeqtl() which won't accept more than one marker per chromosome. However, I wish to plot several markers on one chromosome.

Thanks for your help!

Elisa

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] highlighting markers on linkage map plot
parts:
You could use makeqtl with multiple markers. Consider the following example:

data(hyper)
hilit <- sample(markernames(hyper), 5)
pos <- find.markerpos(hyper, hilit)
hyper <- calc.genoprob(hyper)
qtl <- makeqtl(hyper, pos[,1], pos[,2], rownames(pos), what="prob")
plot(qtl)

There's not much room for the marker names, though.

karl
